source_paper: Silva et al. Predicting In-Hospital Mortality of Patients in ICU: The PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2012. Computing in Cardiology 2012;39:245-248.
limitations: Patient-disjoint same-source evaluation; not independent-hospital or prospective validation.
This cohort has now been examined. Do not treat it as untouched for later model selection.
No exact death or ICU discharge timestamps establish checkpoint eligibility.
Recall among scored patients is separate from detection among all death labels; unscored deaths are reported.
Subgroups are descriptive, may be small and overlapping, and do not explain causes or establish fairness.
No patient-level scores or identifiers are saved. Saved models and alert thresholds were not changed.
